description: Use when an agent needs a page in any language (Korean, Japanese, etc.) read and briefed in English. Input: url, optional max_chars, flags=1. Output: JSON markdown, title, plus brief {headline, summary, key_points, entities, topics, source_language, content_type}; fixed schema, cached by content. Model outage or daily cap is refused before payment. Use instead: web_read for the Markdown only (no AI brief); web_read_batch for several URLs; ai_translate for translating text you already have. Example: ?url=https://example.com/ Price: $0.006 per call, paid in USDC (Base, Monad, Polygon, Arbitrum or Solana) via x402.
